title: CompoWorld: Compositional Environment Scaling for General Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.33665v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automatically generated environments provide a scalable source of interaction data for training general agents. However, existing approaches mainly generate tasks within a single environment, while real-world workflows require agents to connect information and actions across multiple services. We introduce Compositional Environment Scaling (\textbf{CompoWorld}), which expands the task space by composing a finite library of reusable services. Coding agents turn tool specifications into verified services with typed states and shared interfaces, while a world model handles tools that cannot be reliably implemented. A random-walk procedure connects services through dependency graphs, enabling the generation and verification of tasks that require information to flow across services. Verified trajectories support supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while our Completion-Focused Rubric Reward guides reinforcement learning (RL) toward full task com

translated_title: CompoWorld：面向通用智能体的组合式环境扩展
translated_abstract: 自动生成的环境为训练通用智能体提供了可扩展的交互数据来源。然而，现有方法主要在单一环境内生成任务，而现实世界的工作流程要求智能体能够跨多个服务连接信息与动作。我们提出了组合式环境扩展（CompoWorld），通过组合一个有限的、可复用的服务库来扩展任务空间。编码智能体将工具规范转化为经过验证的、具有类型化状态和共享接口的服务，而世界模型则负责处理无法可靠实现的工具。随机游走过程通过依赖图连接各服务，使得能够生成并验证那些需要信息在服务之间流动的任务。已验证的轨迹可用于支持监督微调（SFT），同时我们提出的以任务完成为导向的评分规则奖励（Completion-Focused Rubric Reward）引导强化学习（RL）朝着完整任务完成的方向前进。
tldr: 该论文提出CompoWorld框架，通过组合有限的可复用服务库来生成跨多服务的验证任务，从而大规模扩展通用智能体的训练环境，并用已验证轨迹支持监督微调、以面向任务完成的规则奖励引导强化学习。
en_tdlr: CompoWorld scales the task space for general agents by composing a finite library of verified reusable services, enabling generation and verification of cross-service tasks, where verified trajectories support SFT and a Completion-Focused Rubric Reward guides RL toward full task completion.
